I have added a `middleware.ts` file to your Next.js application. This middleware intercepts every request (excluding static assets like `_next/static`, `_next/image`, and `favicon.ico`) and logs the HTTP method and URL to the server console.

To see the logs, run your development server:
```bash
npm run dev
```

Then visit any page in your application, and you will see output like:
```
[Request] GET http://localhost:3000/
[Request] GET http://localhost:3000/api/hello
```
